title: kith-peer: add attachments field to DeliverMessageArgs and validate on receive
description:
KITH-3yb.6 was closed as done but DeliverMessageArgs has no attachments field and DeliverHandler does not validate or store incoming attachment metadata.

Implement:
1. Add attachments: Option<Vec<PeerAttachment>> to DeliverMessageArgs (serde deserialize)
2. Add PeerAttachment struct: blobId, filename, contentType, size, sha256
3. Validate each attachment in DeliverHandler (before any DB write): same rules as kith-chat message.rs — BlobStore::validate_blob_id, validate_filename, validate_content_type (exactly one slash), validate_sha256 (64 hex), size <= 104857600
4. Pass attachments to insert_message_with_attachments (or messages().insert + separate attachment inserts in transaction)
5. Reject if too many attachments (MAX_ATTACHMENTS = 20) or total size > 100 MiB

Why: Without this, received messages cannot carry attachments; the Phase 2 attachment feature only works for owner-authored messages.
notes: Part of Phase 2 peer delivery epic KITH-7w7
